◉　Plot

　　The former famous painter Frenhofer lives quietly with his wife on a countryside residence in the French
　　Provence. When the young artist Nicolas visits him with his girlfriend Marianne, Frenhofer decides to
　　start again the work on a painting he long ago stopped: La Belle Noiseuse. And he wants Marianne as model.
